build_semantic_segmentation_dataset: build a BaseSegDataset subclass to load images and segmentation maps for semantic segmentation training
build_change_detection_dataset: build a BaseCDDataset subclass to load paired images and change maps for change detection training
create_label_map: create a label map from old classes to new classes using the get_label_map class method
update_palette: update the color palette for dataset classes using the _update_palette method to match custom classes
load_data_list: load a list of data info dicts from an annotation file or directory using the load_data_list method
